27: export default class SourceMap {

29:   private _rawMappings: Mapping[] | undefined;
30:   private _sourceFileName: string | undefined;

47:     },
48:     code: string | { [sourceFileName: string]: string },
49:   ) {

51:     this._sourceFileName = opts.sourceFileName?.replace(/\\/g, "/");
52:     this._rawMappings = undefined;
53: 
54:     if (opts.inputSourceMap) {
55:       this._inputMap = new TraceMap(opts.inputSourceMap);
56:     }
57: 
58:     if (typeof code === "string" && !opts.inputSourceMap) {
59:       setSourceContent(map, this._sourceFileName, code);
60:     } else if (typeof code === "object") {
61:       for (const sourceFileName of Object.keys(code)) {
62:         setSourceContent(
63:           map,
64:           sourceFileName.replace(/\\/g, "/"),
65:           code[sourceFileName],
66:         );
67:       }
68:     }
69:   }
70: 
71:   /**
72:    * Get the sourcemap.
73:    */
74:   get(): EncodedSourceMap {

76:   }

80:   }

84:   }

88:    * Babel's generic sourcemap handling allows. For now, we special-case

90:    * The goal of this line is to ensure that the map output from Babel will

92:    * line, Babel would potentially include some number of trailing tokens
93:    * that are printed after the identifier, but before another location has
94:    * been assigned.

96:    * their own transformations. Most importantly, this allows the import/export
97:    * transformations performed by those tools to loose less information when
98:    * applying their own transformations on top of the code and map results

102:    *
103:    *   import mod from "mod";
104:    *   mod();
105:    *
106:    * With this line, there will be one mapping range over "mod" and another
107:    * over "();", where previously it would have been a single mapping.
108:    */

110:     buffer: {
111:       _map: SourceMap | null;
112:       _sourcePosition: {
113:         line: number | undefined;
114:         column: number | undefined;
115:         filename: string | undefined;
116:         identifierName: string | undefined;
117:         identifierNamePos: { line: number; column: number } | undefined;
118:       };
119:       _canMarkIdName: boolean;
120:       source: (prop: "start" | "end", loc: Loc | undefined) => void;
121:     },
122:     loc: Loc | undefined,
123:     cb: () => void,
124:   ) {
125:     if (!buffer._map) return cb();

127:     if (!loc) {

131:         const sourcesContent = inputMap.sourcesContent;
132:         if (resolvedSources.length) {

139:           }
140:         }

142:       return cb();
143:     }

145:     const sourcePos = buffer._sourcePosition;
146:     buffer.source("start", loc);
147:     // @ts-expect-error identifierName is not defined
148:     const identifierName = loc.identifierName;
149:     if (identifierName) {

151:       sourcePos.identifierName = identifierName;
152:     }
153:     cb();
154: 
155:     if (identifierName) {

157:       sourcePos.identifierName = undefined;
158:       sourcePos.identifierNamePos = undefined;
159:     }
160:     buffer.source("end", loc);
161:   }

164:    * Mark the current generated position with a source position. May also be passed null line/column

169:     generated: { line: number; column: number },
170:     line: number,
171:     column: number,
172:     identifierName?: string | null,
173:     identifierNamePos?: { line: number; column: number },
174:     filename?: string | null,
175:   ) {
176:     this._rawMappings = undefined;

179:       source: string | null;
180:       name?: string | null;
181:       line: number | null;
182:       column: number | null;
183:     };

186:       if (this._inputMap) {
187:         // This is the lookup for this mark
188:         originalMapping = originalPositionFor(this._inputMap, {
189:           line,
190:           column,
191:         });
192: 
193:         // If the we found a name, nothing else needs to be done
194:         // Maybe we're marking a `(` and the input map already had a name attached there,
195:         // or we're marking a `(` and the sourcemap spanned a `foo(`,

202:             this._inputMap,

207:           }
208:         }

213:           column: column,
214:         };
215:       }
216:     }

223:     });
